[spoiler=Teaser]
April 2nd, 2000 

Elegant privacy of Alexa Hermans secret family home.

Inside, a fragile hush settles over the room.

Aurora, a gentle white snow bunny with eyes like frozen dawn, cradles her newborn daughter, quiet and perfect in her arms.
She smiles softly, joy and fear tangled in her breath.

Beside her, Klaus stands watchful and tense, having helped deliver the baby. The small room is filled with the scent of fresh linen and whispered hope.
Aurora looks up, a question in her eyes.

[b]Aurora[/b]
"Where is Alexa?"

Klauss gaze falters. The weight of the secret presses heavily.

Alexa, bound and bruised, was awakening in a cold, shadowed room. The S.S.E. has his fathers order. A furious President Vanklyis Herman towers over him, brandishing damning documents: photos of Alexas secret wife, a furry. Proof that could shatter the fathers iron image as a leader.

[b]Vanklyis bitter*[/b]
 "You think you can hide this?

 A marriage to a beast

 its a poison I wont tolerate."

He commands without mercy.

Back at home, the door crashes open. S.S.E. soldiers burst in. Auroras eyes widen in panic.

She scrambles, whispering urgently to Klaus*

[b]Aurora[/b]
 "Hide the baby. Hide her with you. If they find her"

Klauss fists clench.

But Aurora shakes her head fiercely.

[b]Aurora[/b]
 "No. Protect her. Dont come after me. Promise."

S.S.E. soldiers shove Aurora to the ground, beating her while Klaus watches, helpless. They drag her away, setting the house ablaze behind them.
Klaus escapes through a hidden path, clutching the baby close. He watches Aurora scream as they shove her into a van, her cries lost beneath the roar of the fire.

Cut to Klaus, desperate, calling a spy in the United Lavian Republic* [nation]Lavinsworth United Islands[/nation]

[b]Klaus urgent[/b]
 "Shes too vulnerable here. The Oceanice will come for the child next. You must keep her safe. No one can know."

Back to Alexa
In the cold storm of the night, soldiers force him to watch. Auroras final moments are branded in his soul. A rope tightens around her neck. Her voice breaks the storm.

[b]Aurora whispering*[/b]
 "Remember love is not weakness."

Her body swings silently in the rain, a stark monument of pain and loss. Alexa collapses, screaming into the cold ground.
Vanklyis watches coldly

[b]Vanklyis[/b]
 "The beasts tried to kill my son. I saved him from their lies."

Klauss jaw tightens in silent fury. He knows the truth and what Alexa doesnt. They have a child. A fragile hope in a world of ash. And if the truth comes out, there will be no peace.

-Fade out- [/spoiler]

[b][/b][quote=New Westmore;69699651][Spoiler=The Kampi Unchu]Llyndorrans are often known as people of the world, and not without good reason too. After all, their country was known for maintaining a vast empire that spanned across the entire globe at its peak. Even today, you can find at least one Llyndorran person on an idyllic holiday away from their dreary and monotonous life in the homeland, no matter where you are on Erene.

Another thing the Llyndorrans were known for during their imperial days was disease. Many voyagers and settlers during the day brought with them new diseases, many of which often killed off indigenous populations who had never been exposed before to the likes of smallpox and bubonic plague.

And unfortunately, it seems this part of Llyndorra's world-beating reputation has resurfaced in the year of now. All across -Chimor, your people have been coming down with a mysterious and lethal illness, and the first to die were Llyndorrans on holiday inside your country.

First, it starts with a fever. It feels like someone's turned on the heater on a hot day.

All of a sudden, your head feels like someone has split in half with an axe. It is the worst headache you will ever experience.

Then, you find you can't fall asleep. The pain is too much to ignore, and every time you begin to close your eyes a stabbing pain shoots through your head and jolts you back into the world of the waking.

Your lungs start to fill with fluid. You get a hacking cough and you now find that you can't breathe.

The pain and the lack of sleep starts to drive you over the edge. Such is the pain now that your near-psychotic mind will stop at nothing to relieve the agony you are in. You are driven to delirium, you begin to think irrationally, and above all else, your brain can only think of one thing: MAKE IT STOP.

In your dying throes, you start to experience violent and agonizing seizures. Ultimately, after so many failures in your brain, you drop dead, just like the Llyndorran that passed their illness onto you.

Just as in days of old, Llyndorra has brought with them a gift to the uncharted lands of your nation.

Their gift? A virus. Your task? Cure it, before their gift ruins your nation from the inside out.

 [/spoiler][/quote]
Disclaimer: Kampi Unchu is the quingnam word for the disease, it means, "Axe disease"
[Spoiler=Symptoms described]
[b]Phase I- Chatay Kampi, the axe of Ardagan/Sun.
[/b]
[i]"The feeling of burn takes all over your head, as if the blade of a axe is reflecting the bright of Ardagan right into you, the feeling of being burnt, is as if being walking around under the sunlight in a hot day, but the Sun is inside your head.[/i]
[b]Phase II- Chínwangu, the blade of insomnia.[/b]
[i]The axe is hitting your head, chopping while sharpens itself with your bones, the pain will keep you awake, but the exhaustion will make you wanting to sleep, some affirm to see Wapiwán, god of death, lurking on the side of their eye.[/i]
[b]Phase III-Saoanecho.[/b] sea's curse.
[i]Your mind is irrational, bringing a knife and thrusting it over your chest to end all the pain seems a good idea, your lungs feel up making you drown in a sea of suffer, your cough, it sounds like a drown, your body and mind seems to slowly separate...[/i]
[b]Phase IV-Wapi[/b]-death.
Your body is no longer yours, it vibrates as drums, bones cramble, muscles shatter, some try to plead for the gods, "Chilla...kóchñuka[..](Chilla/moon, save me).... then it finally, fail, after all pain, after all suffer, it fails and comes to a end, terminal patients affirm to hear laughs at this point, the priests affirm, this is no Wapiwán, who gives relief after death, this is Sùpay, incarnation of evil itself, the feeling, your muscles piercing, and bones broking, Yácha and Kûnsù, the condors of Sùpay these are, taking pieces of their soul for their master...
[/spoiler]
[Spoiler=The Feast Interruption]
In the middle of the Chây Sapa, the feast of emperor, the birthday of the sapa is celebrated all over Chimor as national holiday, the festival invites people from all over Erene to celebrate, this includes, Llyndorrans, those who came in, were already infected with the disease...
[i]"HAIL THE SAPA!"[/i]
Chumbi Chacat announced on the top of the Chillakóri, the crowd seems celebrating, others eating, while most were seeing the announcement.
"[i]Today, the 8th day of the 56.986 cycle of Chilla, we shall celebrate the sapa for his 27th birthday, a moment of reverence, and[...]"
[/i]
On this meantime, the emperor sit down on his litter inside of the Chillakóri, and waits, he should be carried by his carriers soon, and appear for his people, Chumun Caur showed certain excitement, while a bit of anxiety for the moment.
"I already crowned myself...this is little compared to taht."
He thinks, not soon after, he hears a sound, sounding like a smash to a wall, he gives a look around, and see one of the suchus(priest), he is hitting his own head against the walls, before doing anything, the other priests try to lend help, the infected is pushed from the walls, now marked in blood, he is in Chínwangu already, the other priests offer assistance, praying and offering herbs,  Chukat-Bracay, the court doctor, approached, and then asked the priests to move away, he had little of his equipment, and approached the ill man, he did not fought, instead grabebd the doctor's arm, he said no words, but his eyes, they pleaded for help.
"...His eyes do not emit the bright of Chilla or  Chatay, they seem to only glow with death, a dark pit of death..."
The Sapa commented watching the scene, soon the master of medicines took off his kit, and said to the other priests:
"Do not approach this man, or you will get this as well, the herbs will not do anything against this."
He felt the burn, the man had his skin burning, he commented:
"This is no ordinary fever..."
Back to Chumbi Chacat, he seems to be ending his announcement:
"So may the feast begin, may the sapa make his entrance!"
A silence take over the crowd, seems, embarrasing, while at same time, brutal, Chumbi Chacat seems a bit nervous, and then swallow it back, trying get trust to speak once again, he grabs a piece of papers from a next table and says:
"So before the Emperor of the Silver Lineage comes, how about we...¿ recit poetry on his name?"
He says with a bit of improvised way, and subtle gesticulate for one of the guards check why the emperor had not showed up yet.
The guard, with his Silver armor engraved with a crescent moon symbol, he entered the temple and took in the scene. The sapa stood imposingly on his litter, exuding authority as he watched the court physician with the twisted body of a suchu bleeding from the head in his arms.
"¡ Sapa Chimor!"
He knelt before the emperor with absolute submission, touching his forehead to the polished stone floor, and then continued:
"The festival...the people...they await your magnanimity, the people, they long to see the glow of Chilla on your face illuminate their lives."
Chun Caur turned his face toward the guard, who trembled subtly in a mixture of fear and reverence. The sapa waved the silver scepter in his hands and ordered:
"Tell Chumbi Chacat to wait. I value safety, and ...¿ what is a festival before a divine test like such a disease, me, as the representative of the gods on Earth?
"Tsk, understood."
The guard nodded and then leaved quickly, so soon the Sapa turned his attention back to Chukat, he tries to compress the infected with ice bags, while accepting the offering of the priests of herbs to try calm down the man.
"I  do not have my equipment, but I am trying my best here your majesty."
He says as sweat drops from his chin, not the disease, but being too nervous, after all, he is dealing with a disease not seem by him yet .
Finally, the emperor acted, slamming his scepter against the ground with a lightning crash and descending from the litter, his feathered cloak dragging on the ground until he reached the physician. He spoke in a powerful voice:
"What desecrates this body?"
It wasn't a question, it was an order. Chukat turned toward the emperor, not looking him in the eye, but quietly, he answered:
"I...I...I don't know, Your Majesty, it's not a fever, nor a plague. His skull...it burns, as if a sun axe were burning him from within...and his lungs seem to be drowning him from within. This fate seems worse than death itself..."
The emperor remained silent for a few seconds, but it seemed a long time. Then he raised his hand in order, and declared:
"Isolate this place. The air here is contaminated. I will leave this place, to see my people, with my litter or not."
Looking nervous, Chumbi Chacat looks at the gates of the temple behind him, [i]still nothing[/i], he turns to the crowd, already noisy demanding the emperor appearance, before speaking, the gates open, not by guards, but the emperor himself, not on a litter, just there, standing, he announced to his people at first:
[i]"¡ ÑUKAKAQÁNB CHILLA!(Chilla bless you all) my people.[/i]
The crowd applauds finally, the Chomuña sighs in relief, and then bow for the emperor, who continues:
"My thanks, my thanks, however...I must bring something worrying for our people and nation...the gods, they have sent a test to us, in form of disease...a..."
He stops to think for a while, then look at one of the symbols on the fountain, a axe, then remembers how painful the symptoms were to the man.
"¡ A Kampi Unchu ."
"A...¿ axe illness?"
Chumbi seemed confused about the name, but would rather remain silent, the crowd shared the same thoughts.
"Such disease makes your head hurt as if is being cut by a kampi, and then evolves into the feeling of wanting to end the pain at all cost...alongside a increase of body warmth, we discovered, the llyndorrans bringed this."
He says, as reminds seeing the same priest with products of foreign origins early taht day, then leans over to whisper at Chumbi ears.
"Call Chán[Wànâme] to ask help from our allies."
Chumbi nodded before taking his phone out his robes and moving out the place, the emperor would try to keep the crowd entertained...
As Chumbi entered the room, he saw the root of the problem, the infected was lying on the ground, with bags of ice over his body and herbs on his chest, the doctor remained sit down at his side, he nodded Chumbi to go to other room, he did so.
"Añchay añchay(hello hello),¿ Chumbi is taht you?"
Chán started talking on the other side of the phone, Chumbi confirmed and said:
"Yes yes, sorry if too sudden, but, the sapa wants you to call our allies for help."
"¿ For...? Pata(friend), I am in the other side of the Empire at this moment..."
"There is a epidemy growing, which name is Kumpi Unchu, it symptoms are [i]terrfiying[/i], burning, exhaustion, insomnia... from all the kurakas(nobles), you are the one with most experience by dealing with foreigners, the emperor requested you to seek support from them to help our nation."
"I see I see, Pata Chumbi, I will see what I can do and tell you I will."
Chán answered the call before ending, he finally turned to his desk, moving on his chair, before finally focusing on writing.
"To the THEP allies of Chimor:
Our nation is currently suffering from a outburst of a new disease introduced by llyndorrans, the said disease we called Kumpi Unchu, a disease with terrible symptoms indeed, Chimor has not well developed medicine to deal with foreign disease, even more from so far away, Chimor asks for help in such terrible situation, as we are afraid dark times may approach if this spreads, we are a wave taht never breaks as long is united, as  I say."
Sincerely: Kuraka Chán of Chimor in name of the Sapa Chumun Caur and the Chomuña Chumbi Chacat.

[/Spoiler]
